content.short: KuberIDE combines an IDE, api and infrastructure so that developers can write, test and deploy smart contract code.
content.description: Productivity for existing and new developers to Cardano in writing, testing and deploying smart contracts. Supports all Cardano networks and Web3 wallets conform CIP-95. KuberIDE combines an IDE, api and infrastructure so that developers can write, test and deploy smart contract code seamlessly from within their browser. KuberIDE is live since 02/2023 and available as installable component on Demeter.run amongst others used by IOHK education to onboard developers.
content.meta: Find out about KuberIDE on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
